messages:
Erin Park: Heads up — planning to cut release/2.3.0 in ~48h. Need someone to own branch creation + the cherrypick queue. Also reminder: version bump in version.go (and package.json) needs to be merged on main before the cut. cc @Josh K @Nina S

Josh K: I can create the branch. Will wait for CI green on main. Any blockers or specific backports we need to prioritize?

Nina S: I've got a bugfix that needs backporting — PR #4125 (cache invalidation). I'll open a cherry-pick PR once the branch exists. Marking it with label `backport-needed`.

Sam R: Quick checklist we follow: 1) PR must have `backport-needed` label, 2) include a one-line changelog entry in the PR body, 3) include the target release branch in the PR title (eg "cherry-pick to release/2.3.0"). If it's a behavioral change, we require signoff from release owner.

Erin Park: Correct. New rule for this cycle: any changes touching runtime or low-level kernels require an eng-runtime reviewer. Tag @Liam O for those. Also, do not fast-forward the release branch — it should be point-in-time.

Liam O: I can review runtime backports. Also please include the original commit SHA in the cherry-pick PR description so we can trace it.

Josh K: Plan to run:
```
# from CI-verified main
git checkout -b release/2.3.0 origin/main
git push origin release/2.3.0
```
Any objections to the name `release/2.3.0`?

Nina S: Name is fine. Note that the version bump PR #4130 (package.json) is currently in review — if it doesn't land on main before the cut, we'll need a separate version-bump backport.

release-bot: :bell: Reminder: scheduled release cut in 24 hours. Please ensure all high-priority backports are PRed and labelled.

Erin Park: :thumbsup: I'll own cut-day coordination. Josh, go ahead to create the branch once CI is green. Nina, open cherry-picks against that branch and add `backport-needed` + changelog lines. Sam, can you update the release checklist doc with the runtime-review reminder?

Sam R: On it — I'll add a small section "Runtime/backport reviewer requirement" and a sample PR title template.

Josh K: Branch created and pushed: https://git.example.com/org/repo/+/refs/heads/release/2.3.0 — opening a tiny branch-creation PR to record the action. Ping infra if push perms look weird.

Nina S: Cherry-pick PR opened: https://git.example.com/org/repo/pull/4201 targeting release/2.3.0 (includes changelog entry). Tagging @Erin Park for signoff.

Erin Park: Reviewed and approved the changelog. Quick note: keep changelog entries concise; we add details in the changelog notes later.

Liam O: Approved the runtime backport. All good from eng-runtime.

Josh K: Last call — if there are any late backports, please file them before cut time. After cut we only accept security/critical fixes with explicit approval.

Erin Park: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final cut reminder 1 hour before. If anything urgent comes up, ping this thread or @release-oncall.
